entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-30
entry.content:
Issues

  • Question about OpenAPI and nullable value types #65280
  • Purpose of VaryByRouteValueNames #65278
  • [Blazor] AuthorizeRouteView does not take AuthorizationOptions into account. (FallbackPolicy, DefaultPolicy) #65277
  • Blazor: Provide a built-in component lifetime CancellationToken to cancel async work on disposal #65273
  • Blazor Server: Detect and prevent silent user identity changes on SignalR circuit reconnect #65272
  • Some errors "Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (Not Found)" appear in the browser console panel when updating the Counter file of 11.0 Blazor Web for WASM App and then run without build #65271
  • Perf regression: mvc #65270
  • Perf improvement: caching, updates #65269

Closed

  • ViewComponent fails after migration to .NET 10 #65187
  • The 11.0 MVC F# project will automatically exit when the localhost URL is opened in a browser #65260
  • Say bye, english #65266
  • Native Trace Instrumentation Support for ASP.NET Core as per OTel specification #52439
    .NET 11 Planning
  • For .NET 9 and future releases, we will be publishing packages at `packages.microsoft.com` for Azure Linux, Debian, OpenSUSE, and SLES. We previously published packages for other distros, like Ubuntu. We have stopped publishing packages for distros that publish their own .NET packages. #65268
